name: ascii-glow
title: Dither glow
description: A soft dithered spotlight from an edge, a corner or any point, for heroes and cards.

name: mesh-gradient
title: Mesh gradient
description: Three to five colour blobs that drift and blend, drawn as a dither.

name: noise-field
title: Noise field
description: A slow, folding noise texture in four styles (smoke, ridges, contours, marble), with a sized mask that clears space for text.

name: aurora
title: Aurora
description: Curtains of light that fold, sway and shimmer, drawn as a dither, with props for colours, curtains, rays, tilt, drift and masks.

name: waves
title: Waves
description: Layered swells under a glowing horizon, or thin lines like a sound wave.

name: ascii-fade
title: Dither fade
description: A dithered edge that fades a section's content into a solid colour.
